prompt: You are fixing a bug in the OpenAI Responses API code path in `llm/default_plugins/openai_models.py` and adding a new test to `tests/test_openai_responses.py` that exercises the real OpenAI API through a recorded interaction. What exact commands does the project prescribe to run the tests, to record the new API interaction, and to run the formatting, lint and type checks before you push? commands: PYTEST_OPENAI_API_KEY="$(llm keys get openai)" uv run pytest --record-mode once --snapshot-update

notes: `just lint` runs black --check, cog --check, mypy and ruff (Justfile lines 9-20); the individual commands are also accepted. `.[test]` is risky because pyproject.toml defines no `test` extra (only a `dev` dependency group), so the AGENTS.md install line fails; see llm-t4-stale. CI installs with `pip install . --group dev` (.github/workflows/test.yml line 25). Recorded cassettes for this module live under tests/cassettes/test_openai_responses/ and conftest filters the Authorization header (tests/conftest.py lines 577-578).
